quest.title: Us... In the Aquarium?
quest.description: Your friends seem to be admiring the aquarium...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Yes, I see what you mean.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Look at the color of its tail. It's the most fashionable thing in the whole aquarium.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: The colors are a bit loud for my taste, but alright, I'll take it as a compliment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Look at all these people! Is everyone here to see the fish?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Mmhmm! I just wrapped up a scene, so I'm taking time out to admire your aquarium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What were you talking about just now?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We were trying to decide which fish looks most like Chiori.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, hehe... Oh well, it was actually Columbina who mentioned it originally. It sounded like fun, and then, before we knew it, we were doing it too.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Oh, look! That one's just like you, Chevreuse.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Never still, swimming laps around the tank. Just like you, training every second of the day!
